## ✨ Highlights

- 🔒 **Kernel security update, both tracks**: Linux 7.2.11 (stable, the default) and 6.18.57 (longterm) fix a critical flaw in the IPv4 stack: it completed a packet's checksum without validating where the checksum starts (`checksum_start`). Every node receives IPv4 traffic: update them all, whatever kernel track their image has. The longterm track also gets nine fixes rated high (BPF, the virtio network driver, nexthop routes, NVMe, IOMMU, ixgbe, bnxt).

## 🔒 Security

- **Linux kernel (stable) 7.2.10 → 7.2.11** (nodes on the stable kernel track - the default kernel track, or pinned to it):
  - 🔴 critical [CVE-2026-99999](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99999) - ipv4: validate checksum_start before completing checksum - every node.
- **Linux kernel (longterm) 6.18.56 → 6.18.57** (nodes pinned to the longterm kernel track):
  - 🔴 critical [CVE-2026-99999](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99999) - ipv4: validate checksum_start before completing checksum - every node;
  - 🟠 high [CVE-2026-68399](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-68399) - bpf: Fix UAF in sock clone early bailouts;
  - 🟠 high [CVE-2026-80738](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-80738) - bpf: Check sk_state before sk_protocol in bpf_tcp_*_syncookie;
  - 🟠 high [CVE-2026-90142](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-90142) - virtio_net: Fix resize of the RX ring - virtual machines (Proxmox, KVM/libvirt);
  - 🟠 high [CVE-2026-74561](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-74561) - nexthop: avoid unlocked f6i_list walk in nh_rt_cache_flush - nodes whose routes use nexthop objects;
  - 🟠 high [CVE-2026-74562](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-74562) - nexthop: take nh->lock for f6i_list walks in replace check and notify;
  - 🟠 high [CVE-2026-64020](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-64020) - nvme-pci: fix dma_vecs leak on p2p memory - NVMe disks;
  - 🟠 high [CVE-2026-74277](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-74277) - iommu/dma-iommu: Fix wrong scatterlist length assignment in P2PDMA path;
  - 🟠 high [CVE-2026-74317](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-74317) - ixgbe: do not configure xps for XDP queues - Intel 10 GbE cards;
  - 🟠 high [CVE-2026-74745](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-74745) - eth: bnxt: avoid deadlock when canceling IRQ affinity notifier - Broadcom NetXtreme cards;
  - 20 more without a severity yet (ACPI, SCSI, serial, ext4, nf_tables, PCI, virtio_ring...); 204 more don't apply to Janus's build (the files they change aren't compiled in).

The Controller's update badge (🔒) shows on every node until it runs this release: both kernel tracks have a fix.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **Nodes**: the usual A/B update - a node keeps its kernel track (the image's schematic). A custom image (the factory) of this release has the new kernel of its track.
- **The Controller**: nothing changed beyond the version - it shows the 🔒 badge for the nodes to update.
- **janusctl**: nothing changed beyond the version.
- **The Terraform provider**: nothing changed.
